g.text: Pick a model for each part
Each part is one YAML entry: a type and a variant. A connector is TANGO's adapter for an
external simulator; the simulators themselves are outside TANGO.
The config wires the parts into one
circuit. Every timestep it is solved
A sweep or an optimization runs
